description: Quote a swap on a 2-token AeX402 pool with the program's own math (StableSwap, 8 Newton steps, fee taken from the output): estimatedOutput is what the swap pays on the pool state read now. Refuses, with the program's reason, a swap the program would refuse. Adds `warning` when the program pays 1% or more below the pool's curve (a high-amp pool far from balance).

amount.description: Input amount in atomic units (lamports/smallest unit); a decimal string for values above 2^53

name: aex402_quote

warning.description: the program pays 1% or more below the curve; omitted when it pays within 1%
